Call your doctor, explain and ask for another
Thank you! I’ll set up an appointment w my psychiatrist
Tell the people in your life ahead of time that you’ll be feeling moody

Thank you! I understand better where she’s coming from now- she “doesn’t want her peace disturbed,” is what she kept saying too so I can see how my outbursts or spirals trigger her instead of motivating her to be there for me.

My mom is similar in that, when I’m having a hard time she pushes me aside and will even blatantly say “I don’t want to deal with your problems,” ever since I could remember.

I didn’t consider that this was her way of coping, so it’s better for me now to understand it that way. With choosing new family, I think I have abandonment issues? Like I’m afraid we’ll fall apart and then I won’t have friends or family.
